question: Are the three recurring anonymous DHL 'attackers' front-runners replaying someone else's exploit, serial exploiters, or something else?
verdict_overall: No confirmed bot-vs-hacker race found for any of the 12 DHL transactions. None of the three is a front-runner of another attacker. 0x7248 = tax-token swap-back extraction template inside a general sandwich/arb searcher. 0xd215 = general MEV bot with an unprotected-function rescue/snipe module (returned ~85-96% of four large hauls after a 1 ETH ownership test). 0x6ce9 = short-lived serial exploiter (human-style, per-target contracts, Tornado in/out) that was itself copied afterwards by Yoink.

0x7248939f65bdd23aab9eaab1bc4a4f90956748.label: A: general searcher + taxed-token swap-back template

contracts.0x2ecd8f51fa432415fe8f385b8b369f13eff16f: created 2023-08-04; 5,095 calls, selectors 0x022c0d9f (2,727) / 0x406dade3 (2,366): UniV2-style swap grammar, WETH amounts + token addresses in calldata = sandwich/arb contract; ~2,646 ETH gross returned to EOA over life
contracts.0xbdb0bc0941ba81672593cd8b3f9281789f2754: created 2024-01-13 block 18994780; 48 calls (selector 0x3d35e910 + dust value) 2024-02-21..2026-04-22; the contract behind all 3 DHL txs

tx_shape.priority_fee: 0 gwei tip in 30/30 sampled main-contract txs and 48/48 template txs
tx_shape.coinbase_bribe: direct coinbase transfers in 17/30 sampled; 48/48 template txs: 0.0000-0.243 ETH (sum 0.676 ETH of 15.67 ETH profit, i.e. ~4%)
tx_shape.index: template: idx0 in 5/48, idx<=3 in 16/48; main contract idx 0 in 647/5095
tx_shape.visibility: all 3 DHL txs absent from mempool-dumpster (private order flow)
tx_shape.reverts: essentially none (2 failed of 5189): submits only simulated-profitable bundles

template_48.shape: V3 pool flash() of a taxed meme token -> V2 router sell x2 -> token contract itself transfers its own tokens into the V2 pair mid-tx (swap-back, seen 48/48) -> buy back via swapTokensForExactTokens -> repay flash -> unwrap WETH -> pay builder -> profit to EOA. 65-76 calls every time.
template_48.note: DHL titles ('Logic Flaw', 'Price Manipulation') describe a swap-back sandwich, i.e. 3 of 48 runs of one templated strategy that DHL happened to log

DOGGO.verdict: rejected (no racing attacker; searcher is the only actor)

HANAToken.note: DHL date 20240905 is wrong; block 20827437 is 2024-09-25

0x7248939f65bdd23aab9eaab1bc4a4f90956748.conclusion: Neither front-runner nor exploiter. A private-bundle searcher running one extraction template against taxed meme tokens. Race standard (bot tx replaying someone else's victim calls) is not met for any of the 3.

0xd215ffaf0f85fb6f93f11e49bd6175ad58af0d.label: B: general MEV bot with unprotected-function rescue/snipe module
0xd215ffaf0f85fb6f93f11e49bd6175ad58af0d.class: hybrid: MEV searcher + whitehat-style rescuer/sniper (not a front-runner of a hacker in any verified case)

contracts.0xd129d8c12f0e7aa51157d9e6cc3f7ece2dc84e: created 2024-01-19 block 19043584; 8,841 calls all with selector 0xdeadbeef (calldata-encoded program, bytecode not analysed); delegates to victims, DEX pools, Balancer-style flash, keeper-style calls

tx_shape.routine: random sample of 40: 0 at idx0, 0 coinbase payments, median tip ~0.15 gwei (public-mempool-style arb/keeper calls)
tx_shape.big_hits: top 40 by profit: idx0 in 11, direct coinbase pay in 5, median tip 13.6 gwei, p90 150 gwei, priority fee up to 289 gwei = gas auctions
tx_shape.visibility: all 4 DHL txs absent from mempool-dumpster
tx_shape.social: ~40 on-chain text messages (Jan-Oct 2024) incl. 'Follow @MevRefund', 'dudu has the hugest...', 'ghost of bbc' chain letter; identifies as MEV-community member, plays with vanity addresses 0xbeef/0xdead/0xc0ffee

returns.returned: 130.0 ETH to 0x46c2161adc9c4f1aeb0b39377534501c70bf8ee8 after 1 ETH test (tx 0x3c4fe1bf4bcf.., 0x283a73398e90..); recipient self-sent 0 ETH in between
50.0 ETH to the same 0xed65b99e...4c9a (0x1c5ead31fa..) after recipient self-send

returns.haul: 20.247 ETH at block 19937051 (tx 0xbeefea0462.., not in DHL)

returns.returned: no return transfer found (outbound large transfers after block 20729549: 5 ETH to 1inch router 2024-10-08 is a swap)

0xd215ffaf0f85fb6f93f11e49bd6175ad58af0d.returns_caveat: Return-to-owner is inferred from on-chain pattern (round amounts, 1 ETH test, recipient self-tx, recipient = victim creator in one case); no public statement found (web search empty). Treat as 'consistent with whitehat rescue', not confirmed.

DAO_SoulMate.builder: rsync-builder.xyz (block value 1.393 ETH, so the bot's bribe was ~97% of block value)
DAO_SoulMate.mempool: tx not seen; only public mempool tx to victim that day was an ordinary user claim (0xe097e517.., 17:14:04.456, included 2 blocks earlier, selector 0xc71fcc5d, unrelated)
DAO_SoulMate.verdict: rejected as bot-vs-hacker (bot is the sole exploiter/rescuer)

DN404_FLIX.victim: 0x2c7112245fc4af701ebf90399264a7e89205dad4 (lock/vesting proxy; unprotected init + withdraw per DHL)
DN404_FLIX.funds_arrived: 400k FLIX 2023-10-27, 300k FLIX 2024-01-23; exploit 18 days after last deposit
DN404_FLIX.racer: none: first FLIX movement out of the proxy is the bot tx; victim has no other tx after block 19.1M

DeezNutz404.racer: none found in victim tx list (many ordinary mint/buy txs)

INUMI.victim: 0xdb27d4ff4be1cd04c34a7cb6f47402c37cb73459 (created block 20729548 idx 105 by 0x95d4dc882738af8760cb48af9fd8e350ff604d6d with 5 ETH; setMarketingWallet(addr) then rescueEth() unprotected)
INUMI.timing: drained in the NEXT block after deployment, 150 gwei tip, idx 1; idx 0 and other reverted txs in block target an unrelated mint contract (0x42af92af payable calls)
INUMI.second_drain: deployer sent 2 ETH at block 20729671; EOA 0x43debe92a7a32dca999593fad617dbd2e6b080a5 via contract 0x5b5a0580bcfd3673820bb249514234afad33e209 replayed the SAME two victim selectors (0x5d098b38 then 0xce31a06b) at block 20729672 idx 0 (tx 0x45ce017f5a295f387eafb596b4bcb1192dd1c302ccb9d097d7fa2cdf3008b139, 11 gwei, 0.3998 ETH (20%) to builder 0x388c818c, 1.6 ETH to EOA). d215 did not try for these 2 ETH. d215 sent this address a 0.04 ETH 'ghost of bbc' message on 2024-10-08, so they know each other.
INUMI.verdict: rejected for d215 as victim of a racer; second drain = copycat-after-the-fact, related-not-frontrun (later block, different funds)

0xd215ffaf0f85fb6f93f11e49bd6175ad58af0d.conclusion: Not a front-runner replaying a hacker: in every DHL case d215 is the first and only tx touching the victim. It is a MEV bot whose exploit module targets unprotected rescue-style functions on freshly funded contracts, using gas auctions (100-289 gwei tips) to win vs other snipers, and which in 4-5 big cases returned most of the funds.

0x6ce9fa08f139f5e48bc607845e57efe9aa34c9.label: C: short-lived serial exploiter (OHM-fork rebase/staking bug class)
0x6ce9fa08f139f5e48bc607845e57efe9aa34c9.class: serial exploiter that finds bugs itself; later copied by Yoink

history.first_funding: 2023-08-09 0.984 ETH from Tornado Cash 1 ETH pool 0x47ce0c6e..

tx_shape.per_target_contract: deploy (idx 26..114) then call 12-60 s later (1-2 blocks)
tx_shape.fees: type-2, 14-27 gwei, tip 2-3 gwei, not idx 0, no coinbase transfer
tx_shape.visibility: attack txs absent from mempool-dumpster; one deploy tx (0x7514a063.., 2023-09-05 09:57:28.523 first seen by bloXroute after inclusion)

exploits.name: QuantumWN
exploits.note: same attack contract 0x154863eb.. as JumpFarm, 2 blocks later

racers_and_copycats.evidence: call-for-call replay of 6ce9's HATE tx (pair flash-swap 0x022c0d9f -> callback 0x10d1e85c -> 10x staking 0xadc9772e/0x21d0af34 pairs on 0x8ebd6c7d.. -> router sell); all 10 succeeded; builder payments 1.08 ETH total
racers_and_copycats.order: 4 blocks AFTER 6ce9's second HATE tx (18071199) and 1,675 blocks after the first: copy-after, not a front-run
racers_and_copycats.also: 0x9efc041667e63de659b6150a6a8346028c33edad via contract 0x5968ada2.. replayed the same pair at 18071204 idx 3 (tx 0xc3e8fb9eb81f297eb4c3fb266d8edee4aed6208e2594f6302981e43f0a0bec1d)

racers_and_copycats.evidence: WETH->BTC20 pair swap then 1inch route to USDT and back: post-hack arbitrage, no victim calls replayed. Also a 2110 gwei-tip arb by 0x202bb2fab1.. at 17949216 idx 1

racers_and_copycats.who: none: only 6ce9 txs touch sJUMP / sFumog in +-6,000 blocks

0x6ce9fa08f139f5e48bc607845e57efe9aa34c9.mempool: all 6 DHL txs absent from mempool-dumpster 2023-08-19 / 2023-09-05 (no sourcelog for 08-19)
0x6ce9fa08f139f5e48bc607845e57efe9aa34c9.conclusion: Serial exploiter: 6 exploits in 18 days across the same bug class (rebasing OHM-fork staking), custom contract each time, Tornado in/out, stopped 2023-09-06. Not a replay of anyone else's exploit; the only racing is later copying by Yoink and another bot.

same_operator_analysis.shared_counterparties_pairwise: none (A&B, A&C, B&C all empty over normal+internal tx counterparties)
same_operator_analysis.contracts: no shared contracts; call grammars unrelated (0xdeadbeef calldata program vs UniV2-style swap vs per-target contracts)

earning_farm_0xa57_comparison.finding: EOA active since 2019-11-10; first 3,000 txs run to 2021-01 with 2,450 to contract 0xa57bd00134b2850b2a1c55860c9e9ea100fdd6cf and 550 plain transfers; long-running generalized MEV operator (2019 onward), a different type from 0x6ce9 (17 txs) and comparable to 0x7248/0xd215 only in being a general searcher. Not investigated further.

caveats: Mempool-dumpster has no sourcelog for 2023-08-19; absence from the CSV means private or dropped-because-already-on-chain, not proof of privacy.
Return-to-owner for d215 inferred from tx pattern only.
No bytecode decompilation done; selector grammar only (cast 4byte lookups returned nothing offline).
